elsewhere:azmar_dinar: Azmar Dinar: the Sultanate's gold coin. Dropped by Azmar soldiers (1-3), officers (4-8), Lords (16-32) and the Sultana (80-96).
How to get: Azmar drops; spend it at the Counting-Table in a liberated Azmar village.
elsewhere:azmar_copper_khopesh: Copper Khopesh: copper-sword stats, a sickle blade that hooks a raised shield down (3 s, once per 6 s).
How to get: Azmar Spearguards and Sun-Guards drop it rarely (4%); the Counting-Table sells it.
elsewhere:azmar_gilded_khopesh: Gilded Khopesh: iron-sword stats with the shield hook.
How to get: dropped by Azmar officers (Jemadar, Qaid).
elsewhere:azmar_twin_khopesh: Twinblade Khopesh: the Sand-Dancers' paired blades; iron stats, quick, with the shield hook.
How to get: Ustad Zayan Sorel drops it 20% of the time; Sand-Dancers 4%.
elsewhere:azmar_scarab_spear: Scarab-Head Spear: a diamond-spear-class lance with a gilded scarab head.
How to get: Camel Lancers and Pikemen (4%); the Counting-Table.
elsewhere:azmar_composite_bow: Composite Bow: a recurved bow, vanilla bow stats.
How to get: Azmar Bowmen (4%); the Counting-Table.
elsewhere:azmar_fire_pot: Faience Fire Pot: throw for 6 damage and a 3x3 ground fire for 3 s (2 per second). It never spreads and never burns blocks.
How to get: Naffatun drop them; the Counting-Table sells 4 for 20 Dinars.
elsewhere:azmar_jackal_helm: Jackal Helm: chainmail-helmet values, rendered on the head (not painted on the skin).
How to get: Jackal Guards of the Sultana drop it 2% of the time.
elsewhere:azmar_falcon_helm: How to get: Royal Falconer Leyla Dunmar's guard and the Falconer drop it.
elsewhere:azmar_horned_scarab_crown: How to get: dropped by Amir Tariq Vashti (50%).
elsewhere:azmar_sunplate_cuirass: Sunplate Cuirass: iron-chestplate values in linen and gold.
How to get: Hajib Rustam Qalat drops it 20% of the time.
elsewhere:azmar_nemes_of_the_uraeus: Nemes of the Uraeus: helmet 3/2/0.1 with the Uraeus Ward (10% less damage by day in the open, +1% per Lord Seal up to 12%).
How to get: the Sultana Nahira Zahr-Qadir (DropRule).
elsewhere:azmar_ibis_crest: Ibis Crest: a scribe's helmet, +25% experience from villager trades.
How to get: Grand Wazir Idris Halvane (DropRule).
elsewhere:azmar_falconers_gauntlet: Falconer's Gauntlet: right-click to send a falcon at the target in view: Glowing 8 s and 3 damage, 20 s cooldown.
How to get: Royal Falconer Leyla Dunmar (DropRule).
elsewhere:azmar_sandrunner_sandals: Sandrunner Sandals: boots 3/2/0, +10% speed on sand, red sand and terracotta, fall damage -2.
How to get: Amir Tariq Vashti (DropRule).
elsewhere:azmar_winged_scarab_standard: Winged-Scarab Standard: plant it for Absorption I within 16 blocks (refreshed every 10 s).
How to get: the Sultana drops it half of the time.
elsewhere:azmar_armor_trim_smithing_temp: Armor trim template: applies the Azmar scarab-wing trim to any trimmable armor with a trim material.
How to get: the Counting-Table; copy it with 7 Diamonds and a Lapis Block (makes 2).
elsewhere:azmar_banner_pattern: Banner pattern: the winged scarab holding a sun disc.
elsewhere:azmar_seal_sultana: Lord Seal of Azmar (sultana): a trophy that boosts the Nemes of the Uraeus and counts for the Counting-Table.
How to get: dropped by that boss of Azmar.
elsewhere:azmar_seal_wazir: Lord Seal of Azmar (wazir): a trophy that boosts the Nemes of the Uraeus and counts for the Counting-Table.
How to get: dropped by that boss of Azmar.
elsewhere:azmar_seal_falconer: Lord Seal of Azmar (falconer): a trophy that boosts the Nemes of the Uraeus and counts for the Counting-Table.
How to get: dropped by that boss of Azmar.
elsewhere:azmar_seal_amir: Lord Seal of Azmar (amir): a trophy that boosts the Nemes of the Uraeus and counts for the Counting-Table.
How to get: dropped by that boss of Azmar.
